cancellation.intro.t: We understand that plans may change. Our cancellation policy is designed to be fair while covering the costs involved in preparing and delivering each experience.

cancellation.rules.0.when.t: More than 7 days before the experience

cancellation.rules.0.what.t: A full refund, excluding any non-refundable costs already incurred in preparing the experience.

cancellation.rules.1.what.t: 50% of the total amount paid is refunded.

cancellation.rescheduling.0.t: Where possible, we are happy to move your experience to another available date.

cancellation.rescheduling.1.t: The amount already paid can be transferred to the new date. Any additional costs caused by the change, including supplier or venue fees, may apply.

cancellation.exceptional.t: In exceptional circumstances, we may review cancellation or rescheduling terms case by case.
